_meta.description: Per-material support handling for FDM printing: removal, Z-gap and support-material pairings. Overhang angles and bridge limits live in kiln.printability, the one place Kiln judges them.

pla.support_notes: Snaps off with pliers. Warm water softens contact points.

petg.support_notes: Notorious for fusing. Use larger Z-gap (0.3mm+) or cross-material supports.

abs.support_notes: Needs cutting tools. Acetone can smooth contact points. Enclosed printer required.

asa.support_notes: Similar to ABS. Enclosed printer preferred.

pa.support_notes: Must be bone dry. Very strong interlayer adhesion makes support removal difficult.

tpu.support_notes: Flexible material peels off supports easily but bridges poorly.

pc.support_notes: Strong bonds, brittle supports that shatter. Requires cutting tools. Enclosed printer required.
